I feel honoured to be the first PhD from this prestigious institute. I still remember my supervisor Dr. Nalini was working harder than me during my thesis writing as I had a deadline to join postdoc in Trinity College Dublin. The education and ethical values I received there was stellar and set me up to be successful.

I joined NIPER-Hyderabad to pursue my PhD when it was a budding institute.
